Test Case Title: Login Page UI and Owner Login
Description: Verify that the updated login UI renders correctly and an owner can log in with valid credentials.
Pre-conditions: Application is running. Demo owner account exists: owner@pmh.com / Password123!.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Verify the Dia Oc Hub logo, Email field, Mật khẩu field, and Đăng nhập ngay button are visible. 3. Enter owner@pmh.com. 4. Enter Password123!. 5. Click Đăng nhập ngay.
Expected Result: Owner is authenticated and redirected to /owner/dashboard. Login form does not remain stuck in loading state.

Description: Verify that invalid credentials are rejected from the updated login UI.
Pre-conditions: Application is running. Demo owner account exists. User enters incorrect password with at least 6 characters.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Enter owner@pmh.com. 3. Enter WrongPassword123. 4. Click Đăng nhập ngay.
Expected Result: Login fails. Error message such as Incorrect password or Không thể đăng nhập lúc này is displayed. User remains on /login.

Description: Verify that a tenant cannot access owner pages.
Pre-conditions: Tenant account exists and is logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as tenant1@pmh.com. 2. Manually navigate to /owner/dashboard.
Expected Result: Tenant is blocked or redirected to the tenant dashboard. Owner data is not visible.

Description: Verify that an owner can create a new property.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Database is available.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/properties. 2. Click create new property. 3. Enter property code, name, address, city, and unit count. 4. Submit form.
Expected Result: Property is created successfully and appears in the owner property list.

Description: Verify that duplicate property codes are rejected.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. A property with code PMH-RIVER already exists in demo data.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to create property page. 2. Enter property code PMH-RIVER. 3. Complete required fields. 4. Submit form.
Expected Result: System rejects the duplicate property code and displays a validation/error message.

Description: Verify that an owner can add a unit to an owned property.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. At least one property exists.
Test Steps: 1. Open an owned property detail page. 2. Click add unit. 3. Enter unit code, rent, deposit, floor, area, and furnishing details. 4. Submit form.
Expected Result: Unit is created and appears under the selected property.

Description: Verify that duplicate unit codes within the same property are rejected.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Property already has unit 01.
Test Steps: 1. Open property detail page. 2. Click add unit. 3. Enter unit code 01. 4. Complete required fields. 5. Submit form.
Expected Result: System rejects duplicate unit code for the same property.

Description: Verify that an owner can generate a manager invite code.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Property has no conflicting active manager invite/assignment rule issue.
Test Steps: 1. Open owner property detail page. 2. Click generate manager invite code. 3. Copy displayed invite code.
Expected Result: Manager invite code is generated and displayed with expiration information.

Description: Verify that a manager can request assignment using a valid invite code.
Pre-conditions: Manager account exists. Owner generated valid manager invite code.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as manager@pmh.com. 2. Navigate to manager dashboard. 3. Enter the manager invite code. 4. Submit request.
Expected Result: Manager assignment request is created and shown as pending.

Description: Verify that an owner can approve a pending manager assignment request.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Pending manager assignment request exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/requests. 2. Locate manager assignment request. 3. Approve request.
Expected Result: Manager becomes actively assigned to the property. Manager can see the assigned property.

Description: Verify that an owner can generate a tenant invite code for a vacant unit.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. A vacant unit exists.
Test Steps: 1. Open property detail page. 2. Select a vacant unit. 3. Generate tenant invite code.
Expected Result: Tenant invite code is displayed and tied to the selected vacant unit.

Description: Verify that a tenant can request connection to a unit using a valid invite code.
Pre-conditions: Tenant account exists. Valid tenant unit invite code exists.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as tenant1@pmh.com. 2. Navigate to /tenant/dashboard. 3. Enter unit invite code. 4. Submit request.
Expected Result: Connection request is created and shown as pending on tenant dashboard.

Test Case Title: Owner Approves Tenant Request and Creates Lease
Description: Verify that owner can approve tenant request and create a lease.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Pending tenant connection request exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/requests. 2. Open pending tenant request. 3. Enter lease start date, end date, rent, deposit, management fee, and due day. 4. Submit approval.
Expected Result: Lease is created. Unit status becomes occupied. Tenant can view contract.

Test Case Title: Manager Approves Tenant Request for Assigned Property
Description: Verify that assigned manager can approve tenant request for assigned property.
Pre-conditions: Manager is logged in and assigned to the property. Pending tenant request exists for that property.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /manager/requests. 2. Open tenant request. 3. Enter lease details. 4. Submit approval.
Expected Result: Lease is created only if the manager is assigned to the property. Request status becomes approved.

Description: Verify that one tenant can have more than one active rental.
Pre-conditions: Tenant has one active lease. A second vacant unit and valid invite code exist.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as the tenant. 2. Submit second valid unit invite code. 3. Owner or manager approves request and creates second lease. 4. Return to tenant dashboard and contracts page.
Expected Result: Tenant dashboard and contracts page show multiple active rentals/contracts.

Description: Verify that an active lease with past end date is marked expired when relevant pages load.
Pre-conditions: A lease exists with status ACTIVE and end date before current date.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as owner, manager, or tenant related to the lease. 2. Open dashboard, property detail, contract, or invoice page. 3. Refresh data.
Expected Result: Past active lease is no longer displayed as active. Lease status becomes EXPIRED and unit becomes vacant if applicable.

Description: Verify that tenant can request early termination for an active lease.
Pre-conditions: Tenant is logged in and has an active lease with no existing termination request.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /tenant/contracts. 2. Enter termination note. 3. Submit early termination request.
Expected Result: Termination request is saved. Owner/manager can see it in lease termination requests.

Description: Verify that owner can terminate an active lease.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Active lease exists under owned property.
Test Steps: 1. Open property detail page. 2. Locate occupied unit with active lease. 3. Click terminate lease. 4. Confirm action.
Expected Result: Lease status becomes TERMINATED. Unit becomes vacant and remains in history.

Description: Verify that owner/manager can configure payment receiving account for a property.
Pre-conditions: Owner or assigned manager is logged in. Property exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to invoices page. 2. Select a property. 3. Enter bank code, bank name, account number, account name, and transfer note template. 4. Save account.
Expected Result: Receiving account is saved and used for tenant payment instructions.

Description: Verify that owner/manager can generate monthly invoices from active leases.
Pre-conditions: Owner or assigned manager is logged in. Active leases exist for selected billing month.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/invoices or /manager/invoices. 2. Select billing year and month. 3. Preview invoices. 4. Create monthly invoices.
Expected Result: Invoices are generated for eligible active leases. Existing monthly invoices are skipped.

Description: Verify that duplicate invoice for same lease and billing month is prevented.
Pre-conditions: Invoice already exists for a lease and billing month.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to invoices page. 2. Select same billing year and month. 3. Preview invoices. 4. Attempt to create invoice again.
Expected Result: System skips existing invoice or displays duplicate prevention message. No duplicate invoice is created.

Description: Verify that tenant can see payment instructions for an unpaid invoice.
Pre-conditions: Tenant is logged in. Tenant has unpaid invoice. Property receiving account exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /tenant/payments. 2. Open unpaid invoice section. 3. Review bank transfer and QR details.
Expected Result: Tenant sees bank name, account number, account name, transfer content, and VietQR image when configured.

Description: Verify that tenant can submit payment proof for an invoice.
Pre-conditions: Tenant is logged in. Tenant has unpaid or partially paid invoice. Supabase payment proof bucket is configured.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /tenant/payments. 2. Select invoice. 3. Enter paid amount and transfer reference. 4. Upload proof image. 5. Submit payment proof.
Expected Result: Payment proof is uploaded. Payment status becomes PENDING. Invoice becomes PENDING_REVIEW if applicable.

Description: Verify that tenant cannot submit payment amount greater than remaining balance.
Pre-conditions: Tenant is logged in. Invoice has known remaining balance.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /tenant/payments. 2. Enter paid amount greater than remaining balance. 3. Submit payment proof.
Expected Result: System rejects overpayment and displays an error. No payment record is created.

Description: Verify that owner can verify a pending payment proof.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Pending payment proof exists for owned property invoice.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/invoices. 2. Open pending payment proof. 3. View proof. 4. Click verify.
Expected Result: Payment status becomes VERIFIED. Invoice paid total updates. Invoice status becomes PAID or PARTIALLY_PAID depending on amount.

Description: Verify that assigned manager can reject invalid payment proof.
Pre-conditions: Manager is logged in and assigned to property. Pending payment proof exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /manager/invoices. 2. Open pending payment proof. 3. Enter rejection note. 4. Click reject.
Expected Result: Payment status becomes REJECTED. Rejection note is saved. Invoice balance remains unpaid/outstanding.

Description: Verify that owner can create an expense for owned property.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. At least one owned property exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/revenue. 2. Select property. 3. Enter category, amount, expense date, vendor, note, and optional receipt URL. 4. Submit expense.
Expected Result: Expense is created with status ACTIVE and included in revenue analytics.

Description: Verify that manager can only create expenses for assigned properties and void expenses they created.
Pre-conditions: Manager is logged in. Manager has at least one assigned property and one unassigned property exists.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /manager/revenue. 2. Create expense for assigned property. 3. Attempt to create or access expense for unassigned property. 4. Attempt to void another user's expense if visible.
Expected Result: Manager can create expense for assigned property only. Unassigned property action is blocked. Manager can void only own expenses.

Description: Verify that alerts are generated and displayed to correct roles.
Pre-conditions: Demo data includes overdue invoice, expiring lease, vacant unit, and pending payment review conditions.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as owner. 2. Open /owner/notifications. 3. Log in as manager and open /manager/notifications. 4. Log in as tenant and open /tenant/notifications.
Expected Result: Owner/manager see operational alerts for authorized properties. Tenant sees only personal overdue invoice and lease-expiration alerts.

Description: Verify future tenant maintenance request feature once implemented.
Pre-conditions: Future feature. Tenant support/request module is not implemented yet.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as tenant. 2. Navigate to future /tenant/requests page. 3. Create maintenance request with category, priority, description, and optional attachment. 4. Log in as owner/manager. 5. Review and update request status.
Expected Result: Future expected result: tenant request is created, owner/manager can track and update status, tenant sees status history.

Description: Verify that a new owner can register using manual registration.
Pre-conditions: Application is running. Email and phone are not already used.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /register. 2. Select owner registration. 3. Enter full name, email, phone, and password. 4. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Owner account is created and user can log in with the new credentials.

Description: Verify that a new manager can register using manual registration.
Pre-conditions: Application is running. Email and phone are not already used.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /register. 2. Select manager registration. 3. Enter full name, email, phone, and password. 4. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Manager account is created and user can log in with the new credentials.

Description: Verify that a new tenant can register using manual registration.
Pre-conditions: Application is running. Email and phone are not already used.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /register. 2. Select tenant registration. 3. Enter full name, email, phone, and password. 4. Submit registration.
Expected Result: Tenant account is created and user can log in with the new credentials.

Description: Verify that a logged-in user can log out successfully.
Pre-conditions: Any user is logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Click logout in the sidebar. 2. Wait for redirect. 3. Try to open the previous protected dashboard URL.
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login. Protected dashboard cannot be accessed without logging in again.

Description: Verify that property archive/removal preserves operational history.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. Property exists with units, leases, invoices, or expenses.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /owner/properties. 2. Open a property with history. 3. Attempt to remove/archive property. 4. Confirm action if allowed.
Expected Result: Property is archived or protected according to business rules. Historical records are not deleted.

Description: Verify that unit archive/removal respects active lease and history rules.
Pre-conditions: Owner is logged in. One unit has an active lease and another unit has no active lease.
Test Steps: 1. Open property detail page. 2. Attempt to archive/remove occupied unit. 3. Attempt to archive/remove vacant unit. 4. Confirm allowed action.
Expected Result: Occupied unit with active lease cannot be removed incorrectly. Vacant/history-safe unit is archived or removed according to rules.

Description: Verify that a manager can leave an active property assignment.
Pre-conditions: Manager is logged in and has at least one active assigned property.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /manager/dashboard. 2. Locate assigned property. 3. Click leave/stop managing. 4. Confirm action.
Expected Result: Manager assignment is ended. Property no longer appears in manager's assigned property list.

Description: Verify that user can mark one notification as read.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and has at least one unread notification.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to notifications page. 2. Click mark as read on one alert. 3. Refresh the page.
Expected Result: Selected alert is marked as read. It no longer appears as new/unread.

Description: Verify that user can mark all open notifications as read.
Pre-conditions: User is logged in and has multiple unread notifications.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to notifications page. 2. Click mark all as read. 3. Refresh the page.
Expected Result: All open notifications for that user are marked as read.

Description: Verify that the protected demo seed creates realistic test data.
Pre-conditions: Developer has test database configured and ALLOW_DEMO_DB_RESET=true is intentionally set.
Test Steps: 1. Run npm run db:push. 2. Run ALLOW_DEMO_DB_RESET=true npm run db:seed:demo. 3. Log in with owner, manager, and tenant demo accounts. 4. Check properties, leases, invoices, payments, expenses, and alerts.
Expected Result: Demo database is reset and populated with rich test data. All demo users can log in with Password123!. Core pages display realistic records.

Description: Verify that the login UI validates invalid email and too-short password before submitting.
Pre-conditions: Application is running. User is on /login.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Enter invalid-email in Email field. 3. Enter 123 in Mật khẩu field. 4. Click Đăng nhập ngay.
Expected Result: Validation errors are shown for invalid email and short password. Login action is not completed.

Test Case Title: Google Login Button Hidden When Unconfigured
Description: Verify that Google login button is hidden when Google OAuth environment variables are missing.
Pre-conditions: Application is running without GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID or GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET configured.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Inspect the login form below the manual login button.
Expected Result: The Tiếp tục với Google button is not displayed. Manual login remains available.

Description: Verify that direct Google start route handles missing Google credentials safely.
Pre-conditions: Application is running without Google OAuth credentials configured.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate directly to /auth/google/start.
Expected Result: User is redirected back to /login with an error explaining that Google sign-in is not configured or cannot start.

Test Case Title: Google Login Button Visible When Configured
Description: Verify that Google login option appears when Google OAuth credentials are configured.
Pre-conditions: Application is running with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET configured. GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI is correct if used.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Locate the Hoặc separator. 3. Locate Tiếp tục với Google button.
Expected Result: Google login button is visible and links to /auth/google/start.

Description: Verify that clicking Google login starts OAuth redirect.
Pre-conditions: Application is running with valid Google OAuth credentials and redirect URI configured.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /login. 2. Click Tiếp tục với Google.
Expected Result: Browser is redirected to Google OAuth account selection page with scope openid email profile and valid state parameter.

Description: Verify that Google callback handles missing code/state safely.
Pre-conditions: Application is running.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate directly to /auth/google/callback. 2. Observe redirect result.
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login with error message Google không trả về đủ thông tin đăng nhập.

Description: Verify that a first-time Google user is sent to onboarding to choose role and phone.
Pre-conditions: Google OAuth is configured. Google account email does not already exist in users or auth_accounts.
Test Steps: 1. Click Tiếp tục với Google. 2. Complete Google account selection. 3. Return through callback. 4. On onboarding page, select role and enter phone number. 5. Submit onboarding.
Expected Result: New user account is created, linked to Google auth account, session is created, and user is redirected to the selected role dashboard.

Description: Verify that Google login can link to an existing manual account with the same email.
Pre-conditions: Google OAuth is configured. Manual user exists with same email as Google account and is not already linked.
Test Steps: 1. Click Tiếp tục với Google. 2. Select Google account with same email as existing manual account. 3. Return through callback. 4. Confirm account linking on onboarding page.
Expected Result: Google auth account is linked to existing user. User is logged in and redirected to the existing role dashboard.
